verdict.rationale: Cursor documents several open-format exit paths. Origin repos use standard git clone/push/pull, skills follow an open portable standard, and cloud-agent artifacts are downloadable. Team data can be pulled via the Admin API, the AI Code Tracking API (JSON/CSV) and OpenTelemetry export, though these are mostly Enterprise-gated usage and telemetry data. Missing for 10: a documented user-level 'export all my data' feature (chat/agent conversation history, settings, account data), non-Enterprise access to the data APIs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of a full data exit.
